summary: Keffers lookout in Schuylkill County, PA: round cab on a former radar tower; 2015 bid to dismantle it; 2017 report puts its top cab in storage at a district office.

facts.design: round wooden cab built on a metal tower that originally supported a domed military radar (per NHLR)
facts.status_note: A 2015 bid notice called for the tower to be taken down in its entirety; a 2017 FFLA report says the top cab was at the District 18 (Weiser) office near Aristes. No source found shows a tower standing now.

access.note: No public-access source found. The 2015 dismantling notice and 2017 report suggest no standing tower to visit.

corrections.why: A 2015 bid notice called for the tower to be dismantled in its entirety, and a 2017 report places its top cab at a district office awaiting refurbishing. No source found says a tower still stands at the site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR says the round cab sits on a metal tower that first supported a domed military radar. The Forest Lookouts newspaper dates place a state tower at Keffers in 1921 and a planned air-interceptor use in 1941, so the order of the metal frame and the radar use is not clear. The story says the account does not fit the dates and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Current status is the main gap: the newest source is the 2017 report, and the 2015 bid is quoted secondhand from a bid site via Forest Lookouts. The bid's award and the work itself are not verified. The NHLR still lists the site with no status field. Spelling varies: Keffers, Keffer's, Keffer. The 2017 report sentence is quoted only in part. No photo added; no height in facts (no source found).
